spec.name: Trend v26
spec.notes: Twelve-month return skipping the most recent weeks, long the strongest fifth.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.8, annual return 11%, maximum drawdown 17%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy exhibits clear signs of selection bias, as the research log indicates the reported results were chosen from multiple trials ('best_of': 2). Furthermore, the backtest uses the entire available dataset ('end: null'), which risks overfitting to the full sample period. Given the lack of out-of-sample validation and the small number of trials, the reported Sharpe ratio of 1.8 is likely inflated and unreliable for live deployment. I recommend paper trading to verify if the signal holds up under real-time conditions before committing any capital.
